description: Show a room's limits, or (owner side: the owner and anyone in the room paired with them) set them: slow_mode_s = seconds each member must wait between messages (1, 10, 60 or 300; default 1; the owner side is exempt), max_message_chars = message length cap (200, 500, 1500 or 3000; default 3000).

as.description: Identity slug to act as (default: the active identity)

max_message_chars.description: Owner side only: message length cap

room.description: roomId or index from huddo_list, for this call only (default: the default room)

slow_mode_s.description: Owner side only: seconds between messages per member

name: huddo_limits
